newsitem.title: PARAGUAY: Paraguay places $21.7 mln bonds with local banks.
newsitem.headline: Paraguay places $21.7 mln bonds with local banks.

text.p: Paraguay's government placed $21.7 million in treasury bonds with local banks Friday, the central bank said.
The bonds, denominated in the guarani local currency, were allocated directly to nine local banks. The bonds mature in two years and yield 16.35 percent.
The bonds are the first of a total $141 million the government will issue from now until the end of 1997 to finance expenditure included in next year's budget.
The bond issues will have maturities of no more than five years.
